// Why this file is committed: The app reads its Supabase credentials from compile-time defines, so a bare
`flutter run` — or pressing F5 without this file — starts with no backend and
silently falls back to the in-memory auth stand-in. You can sign up, reach
onboarding, and lose the account on the next launch.
Committing the launch configuration means the default way to run the app is
also the correct way. config/development.json stays git-ignored; only the
instruction to read it is shared.

configurations.// No backend: Deliberately available: supabase/README.md promises a fresh clone runs without credentials. The in-app banner says so while it does.
configurations.name: What's Cooking? (no backend)
